scripted_findings.title: Malformed JSON-LD on 2 page(s)
scripted_findings.evidence: application/ld+json blocks failed to parse as JSON on: ['https://www.aspendental.com/mottoaligners/pricing', 'https://www.aspendental.com/mottoaligners/results']. Invalid markup is discarded entirely, so it provides no benefit.

scripted_findings.title: Brand identity is not anchored to any external profile
scripted_findings.evidence: None of the 12 crawled page(s) declares Organization, LocalBusiness or similar structured data with sameAs links. Without sameAs, an assistant has nothing distinguishing this brand from others sharing the name, which is the standard cause of mistaken identity.

scripted_findings.title: Questions are not paired with self-contained answers on 7 page(s)
scripted_findings.evidence: https://www.aspendental.com/mottoaligners/pricing asks 9 questions in its own headings, e.g. ['DOES INSURANCE COVER MOTTO CLEAR ALIGNERS?', 'WHAT’S INCLUDED IN YOUR MOTTO CLEAR ALIGNER TREATMENT?', 'How much\xa0do\xa0Motto clear aligners cost?'], but nothing on the page pairs each question with a self-contained answer: no FAQPage or Question structured data. An assistant lifting an answer takes the question plus the answer as one unit, and here it has to guess where each answer ends.

scripted_findings.title: No structured data on 3 significant page(s)
scripted_findings.evidence: 3/12 crawled pages of type ['about', 'home'] contain no JSON-LD. Structured data is read by the indexing crawlers that build the search index assistants query, and it states a fact with a type attached. Examples: ['https://www.aspendental.com/', 'https://www.aspendental.com/about', 'https://www.aspendental.com/about/aspen-dental-reviews']
